bgRemover.title: Magical background removal
bgRemover.desc: Our AI analyzes your image and cuts out the main subject with pinpoint accuracy in seconds, without uploading anything to the cloud.
list: Accurate results on complex hair and edges
Integrated editor to perfect the cutout

optimizer.title: Expert-level compression
optimizer.desc: Reduce your image sizes by up to 90% without visible quality loss using native WASM encoders.
list: Full control over quality and compression

editor.title: Flexible editing and export
editor.desc: Adjust, crop, and put the finishing touches on your images before exporting them in the exact format and quality you need.
list: Brightness, contrast, saturation, and temp adjustments
Free or predefined aspect ratio cropping
Export directly to PNG, WebP, or AVIF

howItWorks.title: How the system works
howItWorks.subtitle: The magic happens on your device
howItWorks.desc: ClearCut uses WebAssembly and browser-optimized AI models. This means all the heavy processing happens on your own computer, not on our servers.

steps.title: 1. Select or drag
steps.desc: Upload your image. We support the most popular formats (JPG, PNG, WebP).

steps.title: 2. Local processing
steps.desc: The AI and WASM engine analyze and edit your image directly in the browser.

steps.title: 3. Tweak and download
steps.desc: Adjust the final details in the editor and download your final result.

optimizerInfo.title: Advanced image
optimizerInfo.subtitle: ClearCut Optimizer
optimizerInfo.desc: We use the same WebAssembly (WASM) technology that powers top professional tools to encode your images directly in the browser. Drastically reduce your file sizes to improve your website's performance without compromising visual quality.

features.title: Fully Local
features.desc: Compression is performed on your own device using a dedicated Web Worker. Zero cloud uploads, total privacy, and instant results.

features.title: Visual Control
features.desc: Compare the original result with the optimized one using our real-time slider. See exactly how compression affects the finest details.

features.title: Versatile Export
features.desc: Convert heavy PNGs to next-generation modern formats like AVIF and WebP to achieve maximum bandwidth savings.

cta.title: Ready to enhance your images?
cta.desc: Join thousands of creators who are already saving time and improving their workflow with ClearCut Studio. Completely free, fast, and secure.
